Storage Instructions: Store this product at room temperature, away from moisture and light. Do not store it in the bathroom. Liquid forms of this medication should not be frozen. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your use. Always seek complete information from your healthcare professional regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Formulary Information and Plan Comparison: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Adding plans enables you to access general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
